description: Fetch an explicitly versioned compact indicator snapshot. Returns the latest value and canonical citation plus `trend_suppressed` and `series_breaks` comparison-safety fields. Callers must pass `response_version='v2'`; unsupported versions fail closed. The legacy `get_indicator` tool remains pinned to its original v1 shape.

response_version.description: Required explicit response contract version. The only supported value for this tool is 'v2'.
response_version.title: Response Version

slug.description: The kebab-case indicator slug (e.g., 'the-buffer' or 'the-pinch'). Use `search_indicators` to discover slugs.
slug.title: Slug

name: get_indicator_v2
